verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is an API-first server that exposes everything "from a single API." It ships as a single dependency-free binary with a scriptable `curl | sh` installer, official Docker images and Kubernetes Helm charts, plus typed SDKs, all of which suit headless, automated runs. Community reports of easy k8s and one-click Docker deployments corroborate this. missing for 10: explicit CI documentation or examples (e.g. a CI service-container recipe), documented non-interactive or env-based configuration for ephemeral test instances, and hands-on reports of CI pipeline usage.
